, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer did not follow the Orchestrator’s instruction to look up DHL rates and instead clicked into the FedEx rate calculator. This early deviation led to repeated interactions on the wrong site, stalled the collection of DHL (and later USPS) rates, and ultimately prevented the team from determining the correct cheapest option (USPS at $41.75).
